title: Fire-rated Doors for HDB Rental Flats Given Recent Boon Lay Fire
what_it_is: Fire-rated Doors for HDB Rental Flats Given Recent Boon Lay Fire

sections.label: Fire-rated doors in rental flats
sections.summary: Fire-rated doors prevent fire and smoke spread, and HDB provides them in rental flats per the Fire Code.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The purpose of fire-rated doors is to prevent the spread of fire and smoke from one flat to the other areas.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, if a flat faces a corridor where one side is open with good ventilation, fire-rated doors are not required under the Fire Code as smoke can disperse quickly from the corridor.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: So, the provision of fire-rated doors in rental flats by HDB is done in accordance with the Fire Code today.

sections.label: Free Home Fire Alarm Devices
sections.summary: HDB, SCDF and PA worked together to provide free Home Fire Alarm Devices for all public rental flats by end of 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: In addition, HDB, the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) and the People's Association (PA) have been working together to provide free installation of Home Fire Alarm Devices (HFADs) for all public rental flats by the end of 2021.

sections.label: Exploring fire-rated doors beyond Fire Code
sections.summary: HDB will explore with SCDF whether fire-rated doors beyond the Fire Code are needed, and comply if so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Patrick Tay Teck Guan (West Coast)
sentences.text: Can I suggest to the Ministry of National Development (MND) possibly to have fire-rated doors on every unit outside of the Fire Code?

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: They are the fire specialists and we will explore with them if, indeed, that is necessary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: They are very stringent where it comes to fire safety and they impose these very stringent requirements which HDB will comply with.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, whether or not there is a need for more than the existing requirements, certainly, HDB will explore with SCDF.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: And if there is a need to, we will comply.

sections.label: HDB compliance with fire safety standards
sections.summary: The Ministry will ensure HDB fully complies with fire safety standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I understand and appreciate the Members' concerns about fire safety.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But let us take dressing from what the fire safety standards are and we will make sure that HDB complies with that fully.
